# cubepath_managed_database (Resource)

Manages a CubePath Managed Database: a highly available MySQL, PostgreSQL or Valkey cluster with one node per replica. The plan sets the location and the per-node size; see the cubepath_managed_database_plans data source. Connection credentials are read with the cubepath_managed_database_credentials data source. Destroying it deletes all its data. Import with the database UUID; config is not readable from the API and imports empty.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `engine` (String) Database engine: mysql, postgresql or valkey. Changing it forces a new database.
- `name` (String) Name, unique in the organization: 2 to 60 lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens, starting and ending with a letter or number. Can be changed in place.
- `plan_uuid` (String) UUID of the plan (per-node size and location). Changing it to another plan of the same engine and location resizes the database in place.
- `project_id` (Number) Project ID. Changing it forces a new database.
- `version` (String) Engine version. Versions are pinned (mysql 8.0.39, postgresql 17.5.0, valkey 7.2.11 at the time of writing). Changing it forces a new database.

### Optional

- `backup_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the backup policy is enabled. Setting backup_schedule_cron enables it.
- `backup_retention_days` (Number) Days to keep each backup, 1 to 365. Defaults to 7.
- `backup_schedule_cron` (String) Backup schedule as a 5-field cron expression (minute hour day month weekday), in UTC. The API cannot clear a schedule once set; disable backups with backup_enabled = false instead.
- `config` (Map of String) Engine parameters to tune, as strings (for example max_connections = "500"). Only the parameters the platform allows can be set; some need a rolling restart. Removing a parameter sets it back to the engine default. The API does not report the effective values, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `label` (String) Free-form label. Can be changed in place.
- `protected` (Boolean) Deletion protection. A protected database cannot be destroyed until this is set to false.
- `replicas` (Number) Number of nodes (one dedicated server each). At least 3 for mysql and 2 for postgresql and valkey, at most the plan's max_replicas. Defaults to 3. Can be changed in place.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `topology` (String) Cluster topology. Defaults to mgr for mysql and replication for postgresql and valkey. Changing it forces a new database.

### Read-Only

- `billing_type` (String) Billing type, inherited from the project.
- `endpoint_host` (String) Public address to connect to.
- `endpoint_port` (Number) Port to connect to (3306 mysql, 5432 postgresql, 6379 valkey).
- `id` (String) The UUID of the managed database.
- `location_name` (String) Location of the database, set by the plan.
- `plan_name` (String) Name of the plan.
- `status` (String) Status: provisioning, active, updating, scaling, degraded, error, deleting...

### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
